edges.reason: enableTrading sets lastLpBurnTime from the block timestamp.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime plus lpBurnFrequency, creating timestamp dependence.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens records block.timestamp as lastLpBurnTime.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens records block.timestamp as lastManualLpBurnTime.
_transfer keys the one-purchase-per-block guard on tx.origin.
_transfer performs the underlying token balance movements.
_transfer triggers swapBack, which makes external calls while the token state is mid-update.
_transfer may call autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens during a sell.
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet using a low-level call before finishing distribution.
swapBack forwards the remaining contract balance to marketingWallet via low-level call.
swapBack delegates token-to-ETH conversion to swapTokensForEth.
swapBack delegates liquidity addition to addLiquidity.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with block.timestamp as deadline.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync on the pair after burning.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync on the pair after burning.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens moves pair tokens to the dead address via super._transfer.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens moves pair tokens to the dead address via super._transfer.
safeTransfer performs an arbitrary low-level call to the supplied token.
clearStuckBalance pushes ETH to the caller-supplied target.
airdrop_1 loops calling the internal _transfer for each recipient.
airdrop_2 loops calling the internal _transfer for each recipient.
Constructor initializes the owner via the inherited Ownable logic.
Constructor mints the total supply to msg.sender and derives wallets from the owner.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the AMM pair mapping.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the max-transaction exclusion mapping.
excludeFromFees writes the fee exclusion mapping.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private helper.
Constructor registers the created pair as an AMM pair.
Constructor excludes owner, contract and dead address from fees.
Constructor excludes router, pair, owner, contract and dead address from max transaction.
_transfer stores the block number in the holder transfer timestamp mapping.
_transfer toggles the swapping guard around swapBack.
_transfer uses buyTotalFees in fee percentage arithmetic.
_transfer uses sellTotalFees in amount.mul(...).div(100) fee arithmetic.
_transfer accumulates tokensForMarketing from fee splits.
_transfer accumulates tokensForLiquidity from fee splits.
_transfer accumulates tokensForDev from fee splits.
updateMaxTxnAmount multiplies newNum by 1e9 when storing maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount multiplies newNum by 1e9 when storing maxWallet.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes the new swap threshold.
updateBuyFees recomputes buyTotalFees by summing components.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees by summing components.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency.
_transfer enforces the maxTransactionAmount buy/sell limits.
_transfer enforces the maxWallet holding limit.
_transfer reads the uniswapV2Pair address in allowlist checks.
swapBack converts eth to marketing share and resets tokensForMarketing.
swapBack computes liquidity token share and resets tokensForLiquidity.
swapBack computes ethForDev and resets tokensForDev.
swapBack reads marketingWallet as the final ETH recipient.
swapBack reads devWallet as the dev ETH recipient.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the pair balance and syncs the pair.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the pair balance and syncs the pair.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens computes burn amount with percentForLPBurn multiplication.
_transfer gates non-excluded transfers on tradingActive.
_transfer gates automatic swap on swapEnabled.
_transfer gates the anti-bot delay on transferDelayEnabled.
_transfer consumes the from address parameter.
_transfer consumes the to address parameter.
_transfer consumes the amount parameter.
_transfer computes and subtracts the local fees value.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount consumes and writes the newAmount parameter.
updateMaxTxnAmount consumes the newNum parameter.
airdrop_1 consumes the sender parameter.
airdrop_1 consumes the recipients array parameter.
airdrop_1 consumes the values array parameter.
airdrop_1 uses the loop index to iterate recipients.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses the percent parameter in burn math.
safeTransfer uses the token parameter as call target.
safeTransfer encodes the destination address into the call data.
safeTransfer encodes the value into the call data.
clearStuckBalance uses target as the ETH recipient.
clearStuckBalance multiplies balance by amountPercentage and divides by 100.
swapBack derives liquidityTokens from contract balance and fee shares.
swapBack subtracts liquidityTokens to obtain amountToSwapForETH.
excludeFromFees uses the account parameter as mapping key.
excludeFromFees writes the excluded flag for the account.
